P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder photo appears anywhere on the page; the dominant visual is a large typographic block, not a person.

P05.rationale: There is no client portrait present; the case study column shows only a text-based testimonial block with no named photo.

P07.rationale: A single pull-quote testimonial attributed to Conesso GmbH functions as minimal social proof, but there is no logo wall, rating card, or review grid.

P10.rationale: The large opening quotation mark glyph and the oversized bold numeral/text block '3 kritische Workflows' serve as decorative typographic anchors, though the quote glyph is modest in scale.

P11.rationale: Specific before/after numbers are cited in text (30 min → 2 min, 1 hr → 5 min) but there are no visual charts, graphs, or cost-math diagrams binding those numbers to a data visualisation.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with a headline, subhead, testimonial block, large typographic panel, and three labelled body sections, though the lower half feels text-heavy without visual variety.

P13.rationale: A subtle warm paper/cream texture is applied to the background, providing mild atmosphere rather than flat white, but it is very understated.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photograph is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page is entirely typographic with no photography, so there is no stock imagery, though the absence of specific visuals makes it feel somewhat generic.

N08.rationale: The left column below the testimonial block and the lower-right area of the page contain notable empty whitespace that is not purposefully structured.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photograph; all text sits on clean background areas, so there is no legibility issue from missing scrims.
